routes.label: at a Ministry of Home Affairs service centre, where the card is also collected

note: Eswatini's personal identity card is issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs (its Identity Cards page, read 2026-11-03 from a Common Crawl capture of 10 December 2025, gov.sz resetting the connection): a Liswati by birth brings a birth certificate, and a male of 16 or over his graded tax certificate, which doesn't state an age for the card. First-time applicants and those re-issued a card apply and collect at the service centres; production resumed in May 2026 after a system fault had halted it late the year before (Voice of Nigeria, 26 May 2026, reporting the Ministry). The Ministry's 'Home Affairs New User Fees' schedule, linked from that page, couldn't be read live or in any crawl, so the fee, the age at which it is due, its term and the time stay unknown.

sources.title: Voice of Nigeria, Eswatini resumes identification card services after system breakdown (26 May 2026)
sources.said: Eswatini’s Ministry of Home Affairs says national identity card production has resumed with immediate effect following a system breakdown that left thousands of applicants waiting for documents in recent months. ... The disruption had affected both first‑time applicants and those seeking re‑issued cards, forcing many to return repeatedly to service centres without receiving updates on their applications. ... New applicants were encouraged to visit their nearest service point as normal.
